note: Demand pooling — the V2 pilot feature for a wellbeing county. A person registers interest in a group that does not exist yet; when enough people in the same region and language have, the topic is flagged 'ready to form' for a partner facilitator. Reitti never holds anyone's identity: the server keeps one integer per (topic, region, language) and no per-person row. Topics and thresholds are PROVISIONAL until clinician sign-off.

topics.because: A structured group for low mood is the best-evidenced low-cost step between self-help and individual therapy, and it is the group most often unavailable locally.
Group CBT for anxiety has strong evidence and scales well; demand is high and local supply is thin.
Work-related exhaustion is common enough to pool quickly and is often not served by the public pathway at all.
Loneliness is the one domain a group answers better than an individual session by its nature, which is why modifier M5 prefers a group for it.
Bereavement groups are well established in the Finnish third sector but rarely running in any given place at any given time.
